search_text: published ZDI-21-215 ZDI-CAN-12306 TP-Link AC1750 sync-server Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-02-24 CVE-2021-27246 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-27246 8.0 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['TP-Link'] ['AC1750'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of MAC addresses by the tdpServer endpoint. title: TP-Link AC1750 sync-server Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of MAC addresses by the tdpServer endpoint. A crafted TCP message can write stack pointers to the stack. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the root user.
